column1: # Every float constant sub_82303110 loads from the image, in the order it loads them.
# Read by cycle 1374 by resolving each lfs against its lis/addi base. Two of
# them settle questions earlier cycles left open, and one settles a reading
#   0x8200F308 is float32(9.8/3.6) EXACTLY, and is not float32(9.81/3.6).
#   0x82069B40 is float32(1/3.6). Their ratio is 9.8 to within float precision.
#   So the image carries g = 9.8 m/s^2 and the km/h->m/s divisor as a matched
#   pair inside one function, which is what the km/h reading predicted.
#   0x82069C2C is 2**-16 exactly: the epsilon that decides whether the vector
#   normalise at 0x823035EC runs. Cycle 1373's capsule seeded 1e30 in its place
#   to force the branch, and said so; this is the real value.
# 0x8200F300, 0x8200F304 and 0x8200F308 are the three words IMMEDIATELY AFTER
# the constant pool sits against the vtable it belongs to.
